newsitem.title: FINLAND: HAMALAINEN-TIGHTER FISCAL POLICY OUTSIDE EMU - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: HAMALAINEN-TIGHTER FISCAL POLICY OUTSIDE EMU - PAPER.

text.p: Finland would probably have to conduct a tighter fiscal policy if it stayed outside EMU, Bank of Finland governor Sirkka Hamalainen was quoted as saying in a newspaper interview published on Wednesday.
"If Finland remains outside monetary union we are likely to have to conduct a more restrictive fiscal policy than we have to do as a member," Hamalainen said in Swedish FinansTidningen.
Finland's taxation and unemployment security systems needed to be overhauled to reduce the budget deficit, regardless of EMU, she said.
"A reform is unavoidable, otherwise it will be difficult to cut down the deficits, which is necessary regardless of whether or not we take part in monetary union," Hamalainen said
She also said EMU membership would increase Finland's credibility abroad, but did not elaborate. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
